title: informalize.yaml, version 1
description: The settings of one informalization companion, docs/proposals/informalize.md section 5.1, as a JSON Schema for a reader (the file itself is YAML). The identifier above names this schema and is never fetched. The implementation is scripts/informalize/config.py, which also checks what a schema cannot: that the module is under the prefix and that workers plus reviewers stay under the workspace's concurrent sessions. tests/test_informalize_cli.py holds the keys, the patterns and the licenses to that module.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and -, at most 40 characters, so that <id>-lib is a universe id and <id>-<phase>-<n> a run id.

prefix.description: The module prefix of the library's own modules.

license.description: null until I1 reads the library's license file; set by hand with init --library-license.

library_cache.description: Let I1 run the library's own cache script, which may download and run code.

reference.description: The reference work whose numbers the text cites: a citation line, never a sentence of the work.

caps.description: What cf plan-informalize uses when its flags are absent.

max_cost_per_phase.description: Dollars; null leaves each plan to name its own --max-cost.

agent_timeout.description: The bridge's duration format, from 5m to 3h.
